description: ANALYSIS-BY-SYNTHESIS READING as a cognitive_tick-driven graph fixpoint. A PredictiveReadingStage (minted by predictive_reading.read_arc_predictively, carrying the target arc text + the discourse context + the WriterStyle it predicts from) is DISPATCHED by pr_dispatch the moment a WriterStyle model exists; the predictive_read_advance Reflex then runs the dispatched stage's thin non-branching executor (predictive_reading._advance_predictive_stage, the reading_drive._advance_unit_stage precedent): it SYNTHESIZES the predicted next words from the writer model + context (the production faculty run forward), DECODES the arriving words against that synthesized prediction as a ShapeDecode collapse (the residual IS the surprise), and mints a PredictiveRead carrying the confirm-vs-surprise split. There is NO Python predict/compare loop and NO run_rules/fire_reflexes hand-pump -- the reflex advances ONE stage per firing and cognitive_tick drives it. reading and writing are ONE model run in opposite directions.

microtheory.name: predictive_reading
microtheory.description: Reading as analysis-by-synthesis: the reader synthesizes what the writer will write (production run forward, conditioned on a graph-resident WriterStyle/AudienceCentroid + the recurring Throughline beat + the discourse context), compares it to the arriving words via a ShapeDecode collapse, and the residual (prediction error) is the comprehension signal -- low residual reads fast (confirmed), high residual is the deep order-N processing (surprise).

rules.name: pr_dispatch
rules.comment: Fire the predictive read the moment a WriterStyle model exists (the reader HAS a model of the writer to synthesize from). The precondition is Exists a WriterStyle; the stage's own writer_style attr names which one the executor reads. run_rules dispatches the stage; cognitive_tick's reflex then advances it.
